description: Merged cells on an Excel-style shell in the Svelte 5 data grid. Column letters run across the top and row numbers down the left, and the first rows hold a complete invoice assembled from MergeSpec and CellBorderSpec entries: a brand band, bill-from and bill-to address blocks, a meta block, line items, totals, a notes box and signature lines. Quantity, rate, addresses and notes are editable and the amount, subtotal, tax and total recompute on every commit; below the invoice the sheet is empty for free typing.

faq.question: How do I merge cells?
faq.answer: Add a MergeSpec to spreadsheetLayout with the top-left cell and the number of rows and columns to span. The grid renders the anchor cell across the area and hides the covered cells.

faq.question: Can merged cells be edited?
faq.answer: Yes. The anchor cell is a normal editable cell; the address blocks and notes here are merged ranges with a text editor, and typing writes to the anchor's field.

faq.question: How do the totals update?
faq.answer: onCellValueChange recomputes amount per line, then subtotal, tax and total, and writes them back into the rows the merged total cells read from.
